4. LVMBRICOS ad uentriculum ascendere prohibentibus, stypticis, & amaris, & aceto, sumptis, & uentriculo admotis: ut, oleis, cataplasmatibus, unguentis, emplastris.

5. LVMBRICOS deorsum trahentib. dulcibus, ut lacte iniecto clystere cum melle, nisi febris adest: tunc ius carnium cum saccharo injiciatur. Siaut sint ascarides ad sedem hærentes, balanus ex bombace illito oleis amaris, vel aloë, felle vaccino soluta: vel balanus ex lardo pinguí, cum filo, dum retrahetur, vermes plurimos sibi hærentes, referet. Vsu crebro diutino salsorum, amarorum, acriū, aceti, necantur & expelluntur.

main_text.head: HAEMORRHOIDON CVRATIO.
main_text.p: HAEMORRHOIDVM venarū fluor non ante est stringendus, quàm vacuationis copia vires deijciat, & sanguis pro nigro & crasso, melior iam fluat: à magnis

page.notes: The final word "gnis" is printed at the right margin end of the last line, as a continuation of "magnis". The large initial H in "HAEMORRHOIDVM" is a woodcut-style decorative initial. Some words are uncertain due to the italic type and show-through; the text was read from the scan as printed.
